subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

It was at the summit in Vienna (1)/ where the treaty was officially ratified, (2)/ thereby bringing to an end (3)/ decades of political uncertainty in the region. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence follows an **emphatic or cleft structure** beginning with **It was**.
 
• In such constructions the correct conjunction used is **that** not **where**.
 
• The correct structure is **It was + place or time + that + clause**.
 
• Hence the error lies in** part 2 **where **where** should be replaced with **that**.

Correct sentence: *It was at the summit in Vienna **that** the treaty was officially ratified thereby bringing to an end decades of political uncertainty in the region*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cleft Sentences**

 
 
• **Structure:** It is or was + emphasized element + that + remaining clause.
 
• **Example:** It was the manager that approved the proposal.
 
 
 
• **Use of where**
 
 
• **Where** is used in relative clauses referring to place.
 
• **Example:** This is the city where the conference was held.
